page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized server powered by a dedicated 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor. The instance features 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core, backed by 8.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache specifications include 48 KB of L1d cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache per socket. Advanced CPU instruction sets supported include AVX, AVX-512 (F and VNNI), AES, VAES, SHA-NI, and FMA. Hypervisor execution is managed via KVM. The instance provides 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, contains no discrete GPUs, and provides no local storage, requiring external network-attached storage.

Benchmark testing reflects balanced single-core performance alongside modest multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics. The instance achieved a single-core stress-ng score of 1881.08 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1569.0, both placing in average performance tiers. Single-threaded gzip compression reached 28.12 GB/sec and bzip3 single-threaded decompression recorded 10.88 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks showed constrained parallel execution scaling, with multi-core stress-ng scoring 3880.59 and Geekbench multi-core scoring 3355.0. Memory bandwidth testing registered 28.84 GB/sec for uncached large block reads and 23.66 GB/sec for writes. Synthetic application tests recorded 3.96 million operations per second in Redis SET tasks and 6.17 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

The hardware configuration provides dedicated compute resources for predictable execution of low-thread workloads. The 8.0 GB memory footprint presents a resource tradeoff for memory-dense or parallel processing applications, while reliance on block storage requires network storage attachments. Considering its single-core stability and 3 Gbps baseline networking, Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.xlarge is suitable for lightweight web serving, microservices, entry-level API gateways, basic data parsing, and general single-threaded batch tasks.
